thread:
oncall-bot: SLO ALERT (auto): region=eu-west-2 hosted-inference.gateway p99 latency > 30s, 5xx_fraction=4.8% over 5m. Pager: https://pd.redwood.example/INC-48291 :rotating_light:

sre-maya: seeing spikes in 504/502 from gateway - a bunch of customer tickets coming in. starting triage.

support-jess: received 3 escalations in last 10m, examples attached (cust A, cust B). they report requests hang then 502. sending sample request bodies.

leo-eng: I rolled a small change to the prefetch worker yesterday that touched connection pooling (deploy 18m ago). reverting now just in case.

infra-aaron: metrics: prefetch_queue_length jumped, prefetch_worker_cpu high, and kv-cache miss rate increased in euw2. could be thrash.

sre-maya: quick log query showing 502s grouped by upstream and path:
```
index=logs service=gateway region=euw2 status>=500 | stats count() by upstream, path | sort -count
```

sre-maya: traces look weird — most traces stop at gateway proxy, no downstream prefetch spans for many requests. possible sampling or missing instrumentation.

leo-eng: trying immediate revert to previous prefetch deploy (v2.13 -> v2.12). kicking rollback.

infra-aaron: scaling prefetch workers x1.5 in euw2 as mitigation (temp). command: `k scale deploy/prefetch-eu-west-2 --replicas=9` — doing now.

sre-maya: repro curl that matches customer payloads (small prompt, streaming off):
```bash
curl -v -H "Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN" -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
  -d '{"model":"gpt-large","input":"short prompt"}' \
  https://api.redwood.example/v1/generate?region=euw2
```

support-jess: will post that repro to ticket thread and ask for timestamps. customers confirm requests around 13:05-13:20 UTC.

leo-eng: rollback complete, new pods coming up (image v2.12). watching.

infra-aaron: scaling done, prefetch replicas from 6 -> 9. backlog reduced in the last 60s.

sre-maya: good sign — gateway 5xx fraction down to ~1.2% on latest window. trace coverage still low for earlier spans; need to check sampler/config.

sre-maya: for future detection we should alert on probe vs real-traffic trace coverage gap — probes show low p99 but real requests missing spans. adding a dashboard widget and a log rule.

leo-eng: note: deployed change touched keepalive params for prefetch clients, might explain connection churn + kv cache misses. adding longer keepalive and bumping connection pool size in next patch.

infra-aaron: created temporary Grafana panel: https://grafana.redwood.example/d/abcd/prefetch-backlog?orgId=1 (reflected queue and replica counts).

support-jess: updating customers — telling them we rolled back and scaled prefetch, monitoring. will confirm when they see normal behavior.

sre-maya: followups: 1) investigate trace sampling and instrumentation for prefetch service (why spans drop). 2) schedule a postmortem if we see repeat. 3) add a short-term synthetic test that exercises prefetch path specifically.

oncall-bot: Incident status: mitigation in-progress — service impact reduced. Auto-update in 15m.

sre-maya: closing active channel if stable, will keep monitoring for 30m. please ping if any customer reports recur. :thumbsup:
